mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy or if S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to increased corporate costs or if S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST does not correlate with increased economic activity or if S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of periods following sustained HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not lead to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS does not correlate with increased consumer demand or if S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of periods following sustained RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a low-inflation, accommodative monetary policy environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions do not lead to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
